findings.evidence: Symmetry.lean:330-338 vs 271-280; no `@[expose]` in the file, unlike Mathlib's `GeckConstruction/Basic.lean` (`@[expose] public section`).
findings.fix: Delete `geckLieAut` and `geckLieAut_apply`; callers use `geckLieEquiv` with `P₂ := P`. If an automorphism-specific declaration is wanted, give it content `geckLieEquiv` does not have (e.g. a `LieAut`-valued monoid hom with `_one`/`_mul` lemmas).
findings.issue: `geckLieAut` is literally `geckLieEquiv g τ hτ` at `P₂ := P`, `b₂ := b` (line 332), where `geckLieEquiv` already has type `lieAlgebra b ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ lieAlgebra b`; `geckLieAut_apply` (line 335) restates `geckLieEquiv_apply` (line 277). Since the file is a plain `public section` (no `@[expose]`), the body is hidden downstream and no lemma states the two are equal, so every future result about one must be duplicated for the other.

findings.evidence: Symmetry.lean:127-135, 271-280; TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/UniversalEnveloping/Kostant/RootSubgroup/NumberedSymmetry.lean:70 (`hθM`) and :196-197 (`hn : ∀ v, (θ ^ n) v = v`); Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Subalgebra.lean:846 (`ofSubalgebras_symm_apply`).
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] geckIndexEquiv_symm_inl : (geckIndexEquiv g τ).symm (Sum.inl j) = Sum.inl (τ.symm j)` and `geckIndexEquiv_symm_inr` (`Sum.inr (g.indexEquiv.symm j)`), plus `geckModuleEquiv_symm_apply` and `geckLieEquiv_symm_apply` (the latter is `LieEquiv.ofSubalgebras_symm_apply`).
findings.issue: The characteristic API covers only the forward direction. `geckModuleEquiv_apply`'s RHS is `v ((geckIndexEquiv g τ).symm x)`, but there are only `geckIndexEquiv_inl`/`_inr` (lines 112, 119) and no `_symm_inl`/`_symm_inr`, and the body of `geckIndexEquiv` is not exposed — so after the simp set fires, a consumer is left with an irreducible `(geckIndexEquiv g τ).symm (Sum.inl j)` and must hand-roll `Equiv.symm_apply_eq` each time. `(geckModuleEquiv g τ).symm` and `(geckLieEquiv g τ hτ).symm` have no lemma at all. This is exactly what the named consumer needs: `kostantElementaryNumberedSymmetryAut` takes `hθM : ∀ v, θ v ∈ M ↔ v ∈ M` and `kostantElementaryNumberedSymmetryAut_pow_eq_one` takes `∀ v, (θ ^ n) v = v`, both of which are coordinatewise computations with `θ⁻¹`.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/SimplyConnectedRootDatum/LieAlgebra.lean:233 `def geckLieEquiv : t.lieAlgebra ht ≃ₗ⁅ℚ⁆ RootPairing.GeckConstruction.lieAlgebra (t.rationalBase ht)`, used at :242-243 and :248-251.
findings.fix: Rename the new declaration (e.g. `geckLieEquivOfEquiv`, matching `geckIndexEquiv`/`geckModuleEquiv`'s role-naming) or place the symmetry API in a dedicated namespace such as `TauCeti.GeckConstruction`.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.geckLieEquiv` collides with the pre-existing `TauCeti.DynkinType.geckLieEquiv`, which denotes something else (the identification `t.lieAlgebra ht ≃ₗ⁅ℚ⁆ GeckConstruction.lieAlgebra (t.rationalBase ht)`). The follow-up work this PR describes lives in `TauCeti.DynkinType`, where the bare name silently resolves to the existing declaration.

summary: The surface is mostly well-scoped, but `geckLieAut` is a content-free duplicate of `geckLieEquiv` with an unexposed body, the inverse direction of `geckIndexEquiv`/`geckModuleEquiv`/`geckLieEquiv` has no lemmas at all, and `TauCeti.geckLieEquiv` collides with the existing `TauCeti.DynkinType.geckLieEquiv`.
